g.text: Palace layout · supporting roofs and receding ward ranges
Front and side elevations control the architecture. Outlines derive from Blender geometry.
23 proposed groups: W01–W12 frontage · W13–W17 recessed wings · W18–W23 rear ranges
L0: arrival roof 210 m · L1: court roof 335 m · L2: north roof 500 m · L3: royal roof 620 m
World elevations; terrace foot is 120 m. Each upper occupied range rests on its supporting roof.
Levels and depths are proposed interpretations. Highest tower remains 1,100 m above the foot.
